// if: a middleware-style guard. The condition is one of a declared
// bool name, a bool field path, or a call returning bool; else if
// chains, nesting works, and every name an arm writes is declared
// before the if.
req := http.NewRequest("GET", "https://example.com/api/users");
ok := strings.HasPrefix(req.URL.Path, "/api");
assert.True(tb, ok);

route := "";
if ok {
	route = "api";
} else {
	route = "static";
}
assert.Equal(tb, "api", route);

// A bool field path as the condition, and an else if chain.
verdict := "";
if req.Close {
	verdict = "close";
} else if ok {
	verdict = "keep";
} else {
	verdict = "drop";
}
assert.Equal(tb, "keep", verdict);

// A call as the condition, a nested if, and no else arm.
label := "none";
if strings.HasPrefix(req.URL.Path, "/api") {
	if req.Close {
		label = "api-close";
	} else {
		label = "api-alive";
	}
}
assert.Equal(tb, "api-alive", label);
